svg.aria-label: Built to be trusted. No voiceprint stored: Nothing biometric to leak, and nothing for a customer to enrol. The LLM never decides: It only understands the caller. Rules in policy.yaml give every Verdict. Tamper-evident trail: Insert-only, hash-chained events. An edit or delete shows on the Console. One-time signed receipts: An Ed25519 JWT that core banking checks and redeems once before acting. Alert and Voice Pause: The real customer's phone is alerted and risky voice requests pause. Attack Wave alarm: 3 customers blocked in 15 minutes puts every risky request under review.
